QUOTE: `_loader.find()` checks `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, then `~/.entropic/entropic/lib/` and `~/.entropic/lib/`, and finally falls back to `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the resolution order of environment overrides, then a default user directory with two layouts (`~/.entropic/entropic/lib/` and `~/.entropic/lib/`), then the system library lookup via `find_library`. This is close enough to the item's "two layouts per root" and "system library cache".
